newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa Q3 affected by nonrecurring items.
newsitem.headline: Televisa Q3 affected by nonrecurring items.

text.p: Mexican media giant Grupo Televisa SA de CV said on Wednesday that its third quarter results were affected by non-recurring items, mainly severance payments related to down-sizing.
Televisa reported a third quarter net loss of 43.74 million pesos compared to a net profit in the same 1995 period of 830.9 million pesos.

"The company recorded a charge of 58.3 million pesos in the third quarter of 1996, primarily for severance payments related to the company's ongoing cost reduction program," the company said in a statement.
Televisa said that if that charge was stripped out, it would have shown a net profit of 14.56 million pesos in the third quarter of this year.
By the same token, the bumper third-quarter 1995 net profit would have been a net loss of 77.98 million pesos if non-recurring items were stripped out, Televisa said.

The third quarter 1995 items included an aggregate net benefit of 1.02 billion pesos from the sale of stakes held by the company in its cable TV unit Cablevision and in satellite firm PanAmSat, Televisa said.
